blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Historical July 2026 review located direct holder intervention on Tempo: TokenCreated at block 12906370 assigned the governance Safe, and role logs through block 32484367 included pause and unpause authority. Those earlier EVM ShareToken ABI/no-hook observations remain historical, not a current all-chain immunity claim. At pinned Tempo block 42066454, eth_call simulations of changeTransferPolicyId(0) and pause() from Safe 0x8eec10616802ef639ca55c98ac856553fadefbad succeed; the same policy change from an unrelated account reverts Unauthorized. The Safe currently has threshold 3 and five owners. The TIP-20 specification defines policy 0 as always-reject and these methods as privileged, so direct holder intervention remains proven even though paused() is false and transferPolicyId() is 1. Unsupported hasRole selector probes are not treated as evidence of role absence. Solana finalized slot 452213366 additionally records freezeAuthority 8trS7JTXGHrHmzE5UUnV1iJ11ipK3tkFZESHdeK2JETn; the entity controlling that key is not established. The issuer now lists a different Tempo token, while the Ethereum CCIP mapping still targets this legacy token; no legacy capability or deployment is silently retired.

oracleRisk.summary: Protocol-operated NAV oracles publish reUSD's daily mint and redeem price. Chainlink CRE writes the NAV and CRE/CCIP wrappers deliver that same protocol NAV; the wrappers are explicitly not independent Chainlink price oracles. The absence of borrower liquidation branches does not make this top-level price authority oracleless.

branchApplicability.rationale: The issuer explicitly identifies protocol-operated NAV feeds as the daily mint and redeem price authority. reUSD has no borrower-specific liquidation branches; its price-sensitive top-level authority remains applicable.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: reUSD supports both local collateral-backed ICL deposits and Chainlink CCIP transfers. Issuer documentation and pinned minter-role reads identify native deposit paths on Ethereum, Avalanche, Arbitrum and Base, alongside their CCIP transfer pools. Reviewed CCIP controls retain Safe ownership, router/RMN validation, peer mappings and configurable rate limits. Solana's 1-of-2 mint multisig additionally permits its second member to authorize minting independently of the CCIP PDA. The legacy Tempo receive path is unresolved after pool-sender mint simulations revert Unauthorized; the current issuer-listed Tempo and MegaETH tokens also disagree with Ethereum's configured peers.

Historical July 2026 review identified CCIP pool 0x258feb106e6d9ba23d61a1ec0f59fade3aaba89e and this token mapping. At Tempo block 42130411, its getToken() still returns the legacy token, but mint(Safe,1) simulated from that pool reverts Unauthorized on both the legacy token and issuer-listed replacement 0x20c000000000000000000000383a23bacb546ab9. A complete RoleMembershipUpdated log scan from token creation block 12906370 through 42130411, in 293 successful public-RPC ranges of at most 100000 blocks, found five grants and no revocations. The actual ISSUER_ROLE holders are contracts 0x2ba8aa49603958b78eb23968039417cd1552ab86 and 0xbb631b504d3d30ee89948afb97b74c1c7eedfeb0; pinned hasRole calls confirm both, while the recorded CCIP pool and Safe lack ISSUER_ROLE. Mint calls impersonating either actual holder succeed, establishing token-level authorization but not a publicly callable contract mint path. The second holder has EIP-1967 implementation 0x6530660eb4834d8758e5c12946a8d0420af45fd7. Neither implementation was source-verified by the attempted Sourcify or explorer reads. At pinned Tempo block 42696278 (hash 0x6b54edd7272abaf2ac2bf8ca177933cebbe3b1a5b792058794e75839e2fdfb06), independent 2026-10-05 calls confirm legacy symbol reUSD, supplyCap 340282366920938463463374607431768211455 base units (uint128 maximum), and paused false. setSupplyCap(uint128 maximum) and grantRole(ISSUER_ROLE,Safe) simulations from governance Safe 0x8eec10616802ef639ca55c98ac856553fadefbad succeed. The TIP-20 specification makes the supply ceiling admin-configurable; the numerical type maximum is not collateral or reserve reconciliation. Mint simulations from both recorded holder contracts still succeed and the historical CCIP pool still reverts Unauthorized. New Sourcify exact-address queries and explorer smart-contract API requests for both holder contracts return 404; their upstream reachable callers and source-backed economic constraints remain unresolved. Failed unsupported hasRole selector probes are not treated as role revocations. The current native-versus-bridge issuance model and privileged caller reach therefore remain unresolved; no deployment is retired, no complete bridge review or incident-free conclusion is inferred, and no alternative route is invented.

routes.reviewNote: Verified on solana 2026-08-19 (slot 440124852). The SPL mint 2uxaYT1f… has decimals 9, supply 7,454,015.258947373, no freeze authority set to a program (the freeze-authority account is an unfunded system address), and mintAuthority ALGjEEQcjtJS7aQXvDPoFTLdp74t1ub9w8rVwKbsSHB2, which is an SPL multisig with numRequiredSigners 1 and numValidSigners 2. A decoded mintTo in that slot shows the live path: CCIP OffRamp offqSMQWgQud6WJz694LRzkeN5kMYpCHTpXQr3Rkcjm invokes ARM proxy RmnXLft1mSEwDgMKu2okYuHkiazxntFFcZFrrcXxYg7 and BurnMintTokenPool 41FGToCmdaWa1dgZLKFAjvmx6e6AjVTX7SVRibvsMGVB, which signs mintTo through multisig member HgkgFRLz76rJA2FBjJQQo41GkViewDngS4tpUKwTkhfo (a PDA holding no lamports or data). All four program IDs match Chainlink's published solana-mainnet CCIP directory entries for lane.offRamp, armProxy, poolPrograms.BurnMintTokenPool and router. Every mintTo in the 12-signature window sampled at the mint authority was CCIP OffRamp-driven and signed by that PDA. Control caveat, and the reason this route is not equivalent to the eight EVM CCIP legs: the 1-of-2 threshold means the second member, funded system account EsX25TxVd8Uc4CFBdqQCZM86aHw7KxxCdgLhpwrArJ8E, can mint unilaterally without CCIP. The sampled history shows no such mint, but the capability is unrevoked and the sample is not exhaustive.
